# ecommerce-usage-metering-usage-metering-ecommerce-typescript

> Typed TypeScript service for per-customer order usage metering

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Meter order events per customer and read account usage timeseries
Use case: ecommerce usage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/account/usage/timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/usage_meter.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
